pages.text: Allows you to set color on leaves and plants. If it has an enchant '$(6)Silk Touch$()', can be used on a tree trunk to change the color of the entire crown at once. If it has an enchant '$(6)Channeling$()' it will only change the color of the leaves, and with pressing the button responsible$(br)
for crouching will only change the color of the vines.$(br2)To set color on the tool, you need to create $(l:utility/dyeing_station)Dyeing Station$() and use one of Dyes$(br)

$(br)(include vanilla Dyes) with Water Bucket.$(br2)The tool loses dye with each use, and can be refilled in Dyeing Station using a dye.$(br2)It is also possible to apply the '$(6)Infinity Enchantment()', which will stop the dye from losing.
